events.subtitle: Luxury Concert 2027
events.factual_description: Blue Note Place presents Kurofune's Luxury Concert 2027 on Friday, January 8, 2027. Doors open at 18:00 and the live performance begins at 19:00; the venue describes an approximately 80-minute program with an approximately 30-minute intermission and no audience turnover. The announced band is Tomotaka Sekiya on bass, Anna Sato on vocals, Hikari Shirafuji on tsugaru-shamisen and Daisuke Takeuchi on piano, with support member Tsuzumi Noritomi on drums. Blue Note Place describes Kurofune as a jazz band combining the northern Japanese tradition of tsugaru-shamisen with Amami shimauta from southern Japan, and frames this as the band's first appearance at the venue after restarting activity in 2025. The venue lists ¥5,000 for first-floor seating and ¥4,000 for second-floor seating, plus a minimum one-order requirement per guest.

en.why_it_matters: Kurofune puts two regional Japanese traditions inside the same rhythm section: Anna Sato's Amami shimauta and Hikari Shirafuji's tsugaru-shamisen meet bass, piano and drums without turning either source into decoration. Blue Note Place catches the band after its 2025 restart, with voice and plucked-string identity driving the fusion rather than a generic crossover label.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo is in play on January 8, actively make room and build the Ebisu evening around this set. The one-night format and precise ensemble language make it one of the sharper Kanto choices, though it is not enough by itself to reroute an international trip.

es.why_it_matters: Kurofune mete dos tradiciones regionales japonesas dentro de una misma sección rítmica: el shimauta de Amami de Anna Sato y el tsugaru-shamisen de Hikari Shirafuji se encuentran con bajo, piano y batería sin convertir ninguna raíz en simple adorno. Blue Note Place recibe a la banda después de su reactivación de 2025, con la voz y la cuerda pulsada al mando de la fusión, no como etiqueta genérica de crossover.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio está en juego el 8 de enero, le haría espacio activamente y armaría la noche en Ebisu alrededor de este set. El formato de una sola noche y el lenguaje preciso del ensamble la vuelven una de las opciones más filosas de Kantō, aunque no alcanza por sí sola para desviar un viaje internacional.
